# 🤝 GLASTOR® Core Support & Community Channels

To maintain world-class Developer Experience (DX) and provide deterministic assistance, please use
the appropriate channel for your inquiry:

---

## 💬 1. General Questions, Architecture & Ideas

- **[GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/glastor-core/discussions):** Ideal for open
  discussions, architectural RFCs, best practices, and ecosystem show-and-tell.
- **[Public Roadmap](ROADMAP.md):** Track upcoming releases, active milestones, and feature
  progress.

---

## 🐛 2. Bug Reports & Feature Requests

- **[Open a GitHub Issue](https://github.com/glastor-core/glastor-core/issues/new/choose):** Please
  choose the appropriate issue form (`bug_report.yml` or `feature_request.yml`) and provide clear
  reproduction steps.

---

## 🛡️ 3. Security Concerns

Do not report security vulnerabilities publicly:

- Consult our **[Security Policy](SECURITY.md)**.
- Use GitHub **Private Vulnerability Reporting** or contact
  [glastor.info@gmail.com](mailto:glastor.info@gmail.com).
